items.title: Ads in AI Mode expand to new markets.
items.excerpt: Google is expanding ads in AI Mode (sponsored results inside its AI search experience) to 10 new countries including Canada and India, announced alongside Alphabet's Q3 earnings.
items.rationale: Primary-source launch: paid placements inside Google's AI search surface open in 10 more countries, so advertisers there get new inventory now.

items.title: Meta Has A New Ad Ranking System Built On LLMs, Plus Upgrades To Andromeda And GEM
items.excerpt: Meta now scores every eligible ad for every impression at more than a billion ads per second, one of three new ad ranking upgrades.
items.rationale: New LLM-based ad ranking system plus Andromeda/GEM upgrades changes how every Meta ad gets chosen for delivery — a fresh announcement, not the earlier GEM conversion stat.

items.title: StackAdapt lets advertisers retarget ChatGPT ad viewers on CTV and display
items.excerpt: Brands and agencies can pool CRM data and retargeting segments around ChatGPT ad exposure in Data Hub, but how a view is matched, and where, goes unexplained.
items.rationale: First DSP feature that turns ChatGPT ad exposure into a retargeting audience on CTV and display — a concrete new buying lever.

items.title: AI was involved in 52% of ad fraud schemes ADEX flagged in 2026
items.excerpt: Bots posing as humans appeared in 64% of AI-linked schemes across 1.2m campaigns on eight ad platforms, ADEX says. Could AI shopping agents be next in 2027?
items.rationale: New fraud data across 1.2m campaigns: AI now drives half of flagged ad-fraud schemes, which hits media budgets and verification choices directly.

items.title: Why Clorox shifted from creating brand campaigns to systems of relevance
items.excerpt: Clorox CMO Eric Schwartz told ANA Masters of Marketing the company replaced big-bang campaigns with AI-automation-enabled 'systems of relevance' producing high-volume, social-first content for Pine-Sol, Brita and Hidden Valley.
items.rationale: A major advertiser describing how AI automation replaced campaign-based ad creative with high-volume social content — the creative-production angle the other picks lack.
